notes: First declared working covariance (IID, 0.25 C); n1 fixed generating mean, n2/n12/pure alternatives. Left columns hold the original alternative parameters; right columns use the smallest converged 24-start distance. Selected mean/min waveforms come from fixed-mean discrimination designs, not parameter D designs. Symmetric-log axes are linear below one and plot vanishing distances without a positive plotting floor. These distances are not real-data testing power; refitted minima are upper bounds on the global closest alternative.
